src: isolated maroon marker pixels aligned by row or column with the solid blue rectangle
path: straight cardinal path from each marker toward its aligned rectangle side; stop on the side cell if the marker is closer than that side's span, otherwise stop in the adjacent exterior cell
trajectory: move only the marker pixel to the path endpoint
dst: blue rectangle side cell or adjacent exterior halo cell selected by the stopping rule
transform: erase the original markers and recolor the blue rectangle red
